# OffboardSet

> OffboardSet is employee offboarding software that turns every departure into a structured handoff: capture knowledge, revoke access, run exit interviews and stay connected with alumni before the last day.

## Product

- [Home](https://offboardset.com/): Employee offboarding software for HR teams: features, how it works and FAQ
- [Exit interview software buyer's guide](https://offboardset.com/exit-interview-software): What to look for in exit interview tools: forms, anonymity, analytics and manager access
- [Pricing](https://offboardset.com/pricing): Flat company-based plans from $10/month with no per-seat fees, and a 14-day free trial on Starter and Growth

- [Blog](https://offboardset.com/blog): All offboarding guides, checklists and comparisons

- [Offboarding remote employees](https://offboardset.com/blog/offboarding-remote-employees)
- [Knowledge transfer checklist and template](https://offboardset.com/blog/knowledge-transfer-template): Handover checklist for departing employees, with a printable version
- [Exit interview questions](https://offboardset.com/blog/exit-interview-questions)
